pyqs.independentSolution: Images of unit column vectors give M=[1,0,−1;2,1,1;3,2,1]. M[x,y,z]^T=[1,7,11]^T gives x−z=1,2x+y+z=7,3x+2y+z=11. Eliminate: x+z=3, so x=2,z=1,y=2; substitution checks all three. det(M)=−2≠0.
pyqs.adaptation: The same three unit-vector images are described as columns; explains this equivalent form before solving.

targetQuestionText: Let A = [2, −2; 4, −2] and B = [3, 9; 1, 3], where the semicolon separates the two rows. If PA = B and AQ = B, find the absolute value of the sum of the diagonal entries of 2(P + Q).
